summary.summary:
Migrated dbt_cloud from pydantic 1.10 to pydantic 2 API.

Core (dbt_cloud/command/command.py):
- @validator("*", pre=True) with `field` arg -> @field_validator("*", mode="before") + @classmethod, using info: ValidationInfo and cls.model_fields[info.field_name] (fixes the startup PydanticUserError).
- click_options: __fields__ -> model_fields; field.type_/outer_type_ replaced by annotation unwrapping helpers (_unwrap_optional, _inner_type) so Optional[Nested] and List[T] still work; field.required -> is_required(); field.field_info.extra -> json_schema_extra; field.field_info.const check dropped (no const usages); PydanticUndefined default mapped to None to match v1 click defaults.
- .json(...) -> .model_dump_json(...) in get_payload.

Models:
- Replaced validator with field_validator (connection/create.py, job/run.py) with @classmethod.
- Moved custom kwargs (exclude_from_click_options, click_cls) from Field(...) into json_schema_extra (connection/create.py, job/create.py, job/run.py, metadata/query.py).
- v1 Optional fields with no default were implicitly default None; v2 makes them required. Added default=None to these fields (audit_log, connection, environment, job, job/run, project/create, run/get, run/list, field.py LIMIT/OFFSET/DBT_VERSION constants) and changed bare `id: Optional[int]` to `= None`. Required (non-Optional) fields unchanged.

Other:
- cli.py: .dict() -> .model_dump().
- demo/catalog.py: parse_file -> model_validate_json(Path.read_text()); Optional fields without default given default=None.

Packaging:
- setup.py install_requires: pydantic==1.10.10 -> pydantic>=2.0,<3.
- setup.py python_requires >=3.6 -> >=3.8 and classifier 3.6 -> 3.8; tox envlist drops py36/py37. (Pydantic 2 does not support 3.6/3.7. The exact Python floor for the newest pydantic was not verified in this sandbox, so please confirm >=3.8 is right.)
- No companion packages (web frameworks/plugins) are pinned in this repo.

Test result: 31/31 passed.

Not changed (noted for review): demo/catalog.py Node.schema is a user-defined property that shadows BaseModel.schema; it works but could be renamed. Pydantic v2 also no longer accepts `Field(..., click_cls=...)`-style extras, so any external code relying on those kwargs will need the json_schema_extra form.
